title: Answer
description: Derived from ISSUE_FORMAT.md 0.6; the document wins. One answer to one question (section 5.2): who answered, when, who entered it for its author where another named person did (6.3), and one item per answered issue.
$comment: Derived from ISSUE_FORMAT.md 0.6; the document wins. Not expressed here: that the question exists, that each item names an issue the question tags, at most one item per tagged issue, that unit is given when the value is a number for a field with a unit companion (5.2 rule 2), that field is used only for OR-rule issues (5.2 rule 3), and that a unit closes only with a value (3 rule 3). The time format follows design/HANDOFFS.md 2.1. The answer in Issue format 10.1 is illustrative: a placeholder in angle brackets stands for a real value, and answered_at is always a UTC time such as 2026-10-20T14:03:00Z. The answer in 10.2 shows only question_id and items, which matches $defs/as_supplied. original_ref is the file reference of the author's original message (Issue format 5.2 and 6.3); design/RUN_RECORDS.md 1.2 keeps full file references (with checksum, size and media type) in the run log only and design/HANDOFFS.md 2.1 lets no handoff carry a checksum, so this file holds the stored original's artifact id (design/HANDOFFS.md 2.1, ARIADNE identifiers), and the run log holds its full file reference. Entry assistance confers no authority: answered_by stays the author (6.3).

answered_by.description: The named scientist, the answer's author, also when another named person entered it (Issue format 5.2 and 6.3).

answered_at.description: Date and time of the answer.

entered_by.description: Optional, only for assisted entry: the named person who entered the answer for its author (Issue format 5.2 and 6.3).

original_ref.description: With entered_by: the file reference of the author's original message, stored unchanged (Issue format 5.2 and 6.3), given as the stored original's artifact id (see $comment); the run log's answer_received entry names that stored file as original (design/RUN_RECORDS.md 2.3).

items.description: At most one item per tagged issue. Issues without an item stay open (5.2 rule 5).

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer into the EnzymeML document, for example /measurements/0/ph (Issue format 2). For software only; scientists never see pointers.

issue_id.description: An issue id: ISS-001 and so on (Issue format 4). Written by software, never by an agent.

question_id.description: A question id: Q-001 and so on (Issue format 5.1). Written by software.

ariadne_id.description: An ARIADNE identifier or local link name: a letter, then at most 127 letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens (design/HANDOFFS.md 2.1), for example HA-001.

utc_time.description: A date and time in RFC 3339 form, in UTC, for example 2026-10-20T14:03:00Z (design/HANDOFFS.md 2.1, Timestamps).

item.description: One answer item {issue_id, value | choice | not_available, unit?, reason_code?, note?, field?} (Issue format 5.2).

value.description: A typed value (free entry). Any JSON value; an object or a list at a container pointer (5.2 rule 4).

choice.description: The value of the chosen option.

not_available.description: The scientist declares the value not available, written as true. Issue format 0.6 gave no value for this key; version 0.8 settles the point that D30 A carried (5.2 rule 6) as this file already read it, so the file keeps its label (D29 A). An item that declares nothing unavailable leaves the key out; false is no answer of its own and fails here.

unit.description: The unit spelling, required when the value is a number for a field with a unit companion (5.2 rule 2). Software writes it to the companion.

reason_code.description: Why the value is not available (5.2 rule 6).

note.description: A note; required with reason_code other (5.2 rule 6) and with the choice does_not_fit, "The question does not fit" (5.1, options item 2).

field.description: Only for OR-rule issues: which alternative the value fills (5.2 rule 3).

allOf.$comment: Issue format 5.2 rule 6: other needs a note.

Issue format 5.1, options item 2: "The question does not fit" needs a note. Its value does_not_fit is fixed by design/HANDOFFS.md 2.9, a design rule (not part of Issue format); design/HANDOFFS.md 2.10 checks the note.
design/HANDOFFS.md 2.10 (design rule, not part of Issue format): an item for 'A different value' carries the typed value, never the choice free_entry.

as_supplied.description: An answer as the person supplies it, before the workflow controller adds answered_by and answered_at and, for assisted entry, entered_by and original_ref (design/HANDOFFS.md 2.10). The answer of Issue format 10.2 has this form.
